chunks.text: ACME CORP — COMPANY KNOWLEDGE BASE ==================================== Version 2.1 | Last Updated: June 2025 Internal Use Only ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 1: REFUND & RETURNS POLICY ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 1.1 Overview ------------ Acme Corp is committed to customer satisfaction. If you are not fully satisfied with your purchase, we offer a straightforward refund and returns process designed to be simple, fair, and transparent. 1.2 Eligibility for Refunds ---------------------------- To be eligible for a refund, the following conditions must be met: - The refund request must be submitted within 30 days of the original purchase date. - The product must be unused and returned in its original packaging. - Digital products and downloadable software are non-refundable once the license key has been activated. - Annual subscription plans are eligible for a pro-rated refund if cancelled within the first 60 days. - Monthly subscription plans can be cancelled anytime; refunds are issued only for the unused portion of the current billing cycle. 1.3 How to Request a Refund ----------------------------- Step 1: Log in to your Acme Corp account at app.acmecorp.com. Step 2: Navigate to Settings → Billing → Refund Request. Step 3: Select the order or subscription you wish to refund. Step 4: Choose a reason from the dropdown and provide a brief description. Step 5: Submit the request. You will receive a confirmation email within 1 hour. Alternatively, contact our billing team directly at billing@acmecorp.com with your Order ID and registered email address. 1.4 Refund Processing Time ---------------------------- - Refund requests are reviewed within 2 business days. - Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days. - The refund is credited back to the original payment method (credit card, PayPal, or bank transfer). - International refunds may take up to 10–14 business days depending on your bank or payment provider. - You will receive an email notification once the refund has been processed. 1.5 Non-Refundable Items ------------------------- The following are strictly non-refundable: - Setup fees and onboarding fees. - Customisation and professional services charges. - Any product purchased under a promotional or discounted plan (unless defective). - Add-ons or integrations purchased separately. 1.6 Disputed Charges --------------------- If you believe you have been charged incorrectly, raise a dispute within 14 days by emailing billing@acmecorp.com with the subject line "Disputed Charge – [Order ID]". Our finance team will investigate and respond within 3 business days. ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 2: ONBOARDING PROCESS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 2.1 Overview ------------ The Acme Corp onboarding process is designed to get new customers and team members productive as quickly as possible. The standard onboarding timeline is 7 days for individuals and 14 days for enterprise teams. 2.2 Step-by-Step Onboarding for New Users ------------------------------------------ Day 0 — Account Creation - Sign up at app.acmecorp.com/register using your business email. - Verify your email address via the confirmation link sent within 5 minutes. - Set a strong password (min 12 characters, one uppercase, one number, one symbol). - Accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Day 1 — Profile Setup - Complete your user profile: name, role, department, timezone. - Upload a profile photo (optional but recommended for team

using your business email. - Verify your email address via the confirmation link sent within 5 minutes. - Set a strong password (min 12 characters, one uppercase, one number, one symbol). - Accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Day 1 — Profile Setup - Complete your user profile: name, role, department, timezone. - Upload a profile photo (optional but recommended for team collaboration). - Connect your calendar (Google Calendar or Outlook) for meeting scheduling. - Set your notification preferences (email, Slack, in-app). Day 2 — Product Walkthrough - A Welcome Kit email is sent with links to video tutorials and the Quick Start Guide. - An automated product tour launches on first login — takes approximately 15 minutes to complete. - Explore the Dashboard, Projects, Reports, and Settings tabs. Day 3 — Onboarding Call - A dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM) will reach out to schedule a 30-minute onboarding call. - The call covers: account configuration, team setup, integrations, and answering any initial questions. - Enterprise customers receive an additional 60-minute deep-dive session. Day 4–5 — Integration & Configuration - Connect your existing tools: Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, or Zapier. - Import existing data using the CSV Import Tool under Settings → Import. - Configure user roles and permissions for your team members. - Set up your first project or workflow using the provided templates. Day 6–7 — Go-Live & Handoff - Your CSM confirms the setup is complete and signs off on the onboarding checklist. - Access to the Acme Corp Help Center (help.acmecorp.com) is activated. - You are added to the monthly customer newsletter and product update emails. - A 30-day post-onboarding check-in call is automatically scheduled. 2.3 Enterprise Onboarding -------------------------- Enterprise customers (50+ seats) receive an enhanced onboarding experience: - A dedicated Implementation Manager assigned for the full onboarding period. - Custom data migration support for existing databases or CRM systems. - SSO (Single Sign-On) configuration with your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD). - Custom role and permission mapping to match your organisational hierarchy. - SLA-backed onboarding completion guarantee within 21 business days. 2.4 Self-Service Onboarding Resources --------------------------------------- If you prefer to onboard at your own pace: - Quick Start Guide: help.acmecorp.com/quickstart - Video Tutorial Library: help.acmecorp.com/videos - API Documentation: developers.acmecorp.com - Community Forum: community.acmecorp.com - Webinars (live and recorded): acmecorp.com/webinars ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 3: SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 3.1 Web Application (Browser-Based) ------------------------------------- The Acme Corp web application runs in any modern browser. No installation is required. Supported Browsers: - Google Chrome 110 or later (recommended) - Mozilla Firefox 109 or later - Microsoft Edge 110 or later - Safari 16 or later (macOS and iOS) - Brave Browser (latest stable) Minimum Hardware for Web App: - Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or higher - RAM: 4 GB minimum, 8 GB recommended - Internet: Stable broadband connection, minimum 10 Mbps download speed - Screen Resolution: 1280 × 720 or higher 3.2 Desktop Application ------------------------- The Acme Corp Desktop App is available for Windows and macOS. Windows: - OS: Windows 10 (version 21H2) or Windows 11 - Processor: Intel Core

Web App: - Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or higher - RAM: 4 GB minimum, 8 GB recommended - Internet: Stable broadband connection, minimum 10 Mbps download speed - Screen Resolution: 1280 × 720 or higher 3.2 Desktop Application ------------------------- The Acme Corp Desktop App is available for Windows and macOS. Windows: - OS: Windows 10 (version 21H2) or Windows 11 - Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent - RAM: 8 GB minimum, 16 GB recommended - Storage: 2 GB free disk space for installation - .NET Framework 4.8 or later required macOS: - OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later - Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 or higher - RAM: 8 GB minimum, 16 GB recommended - Storage: 2 GB free disk space for installation - Rosetta 2 required for M1/M2 Macs running Intel builds Linux (Beta): - Supported distros: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Debian 11 - Processor: x86_64 architecture required - RAM: 8 GB minimum - Storage: 2 GB free disk space 3.3 Mobile Application ----------------------- - iOS: iPhone or iPad running iOS 15 or later - Android: Android 10 or later, minimum 3 GB RAM 3.4 Self-Hosted / On-Premise Deployment ----------------------------------------- For enterprise customers who require on-premise deployment: Server Requirements: - OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / 22.04 LTS or RHEL 8+ - CPU: 8-core processor minimum (16-core recommended for 100+ users) - RAM: 32 GB minimum, 64 GB recommended - Storage: 500 GB SSD (NVMe preferred); scalable with additional volumes - Database: PostgreSQL 14+ or MySQL 8.0+ - Cache: Redis 7.0+ - Reverse Proxy: Nginx 1.20+ or Apache 2.4+ - Docker: Docker 24+ and Docker Compose 2.0+ (for containerised deployment) Network: - HTTPS on port 443 (TLS 1.2 or 1.3 required) - Outbound access to api.acmecorp.com on port 443 for license validation - Internal network bandwidth: minimum 1 Gbps between app and database servers 3.5 API Integration Requirements ---------------------------------- - REST API: Any HTTP client supporting TLS 1.2+ - Python SDK: Python 3.9 or later - Node.js SDK: Node.js 18 LTS or later - API Rate Limit: 1,000 requests/minute on Standard plan; 10,000 on Enterprise - Authentication: OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token or API Key ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 4: SUPPORT & CONTACT INFORMATION ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 4.1 Support Channels --------------------- Acme Corp offers multiple support channels to ensure you can always get help when you need it. Email Support: - General Enquiries: hello@acmecorp.com - Technical Support: support@acmecorp.com - Billing & Refunds: billing@acmecorp.com - Enterprise Support: enterprise@acmecorp.com - Security Issues: security@acmecorp.com (PGP key available on request) Phone Support: - India (Toll-Free): 1800-123-4567 - USA / Canada: +1-888-226-2765 - United Kingdom: +44-800-066-4567 - Australia: +61-1800-456-789 - International (General): +91-80-4567-8901 Live Chat: - Available at app.acmecorp.com (bottom-right chat widget) - Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST - Weekend Chat: Saturday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST (Standard and above plans) 4.2 Support Tiers & Response Times ------------------------------------ Free Plan: - Email support only - Response time: 3–5 business days - Access to Help Center and Community Forum Standard Plan: - Email + Live Chat support -

(bottom-right chat widget) - Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST - Weekend Chat: Saturday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST (Standard and above plans) 4.2 Support Tiers & Response Times ------------------------------------ Free Plan: - Email support only - Response time: 3–5 business days - Access to Help Center and Community Forum Standard Plan: - Email + Live Chat support - Response time: within 1 business day - Access to Help Center, video library, and monthly webinars Professional Plan: - Email + Live Chat + Phone support - Response time: within 4 business hours - Dedicated account manager - Priority queue for critical issues Enterprise Plan: - 24/7 Email, Chat, and Phone support - Response time: within 1 hour for critical issues (P1/P2) - Dedicated Customer Success Manager + Technical Account Manager - Quarterly business reviews - Custom SLA available on request 4.3 Help Center & Self-Service -------------------------------- Before contacting support, check these self-service resources: - Help Center: help.acmecorp.com - Status Page: status.acmecorp.com (real-time system status) - Community Forum: community.acmecorp.com - API Docs: developers.acmecorp.com - Release Notes: acmecorp.com/changelog - Video Tutorials: help.acmecorp.com/videos 4.4 Submitting a Support Ticket --------------------------------- Step 1: Log in to app.acmecorp.com. Step 2: Click the "?" Help icon in the top-right corner. Step 3: Select "Submit a Ticket". Step 4: Choose the category: Technical, Billing, Account, or General. Step 5: Describe your issue in detail. Attach screenshots or logs if relevant. Step 6: Submit. You'll receive a ticket number via email immediately. Track your ticket status at: app.acmecorp.com/support/tickets 4.5 Reporting a Bug or Security Vulnerability ----------------------------------------------- Bug Reports: - Submit via the in-app feedback button or email support@acmecorp.com. - Include: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behaviour, browser/OS version. Security Vulnerabilities: - Do NOT post security issues publicly. - Email security@acmecorp.com with full details. - We follow responsible disclosure and aim to patch critical vulnerabilities within 72 hours of confirmation. - A bug bounty programme is available for verified critical findings. 4.6 Office Locations --------------------- Headquarters: Acme Corp Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 4th Floor, Tower B, Cyber Hub, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India USA Office: Acme Corp Inc. 101 California Street, Suite 2710, San Francisco, CA 94111, USA UK Office: Acme Corp Ltd. The Shard, 32 London Bridge Street, London SE1 9SG, United Kingdom Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (local time) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 5: PRICING & SUBSCRIPTION PLANS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 5.1 Plan Overview ------------------ Acme Corp offers four subscription tiers to suit individuals, growing teams, and large enterprises. FREE PLAN — $0/month - Up to 3 users - 5 active projects - 1 GB storage - Community support only - Basic analytics STANDARD PLAN — $29/user/month (billed monthly) | $24/user/month (billed annually) - Unlimited users - Unlimited projects - 50 GB storage per user - Email + Chat support - Advanced analytics and reporting - API access (1,000 requests/min) - Integrations: Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 PROFESSIONAL PLAN — $79/user/month (billed monthly) | $64/user/month (billed annually) - Everything in Standard - 500 GB storage per user - Phone support + dedicated account manager -

(billed annually) - Unlimited users - Unlimited projects - 50 GB storage per user - Email + Chat support - Advanced analytics and reporting - API access (1,000 requests/min) - Integrations: Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 PROFESSIONAL PLAN — $79/user/month (billed monthly) | $64/user/month (billed annually) - Everything in Standard - 500 GB storage per user - Phone support + dedicated account manager - Custom workflows and automation - SSO (SAML 2.0) - Advanced security: audit logs, IP whitelisting - API access (5,000 requests/min) ENTERPRISE PLAN — Custom pricing - Everything in Professional - Unlimited storage - 24/7 priority support + CSM + TAM - On-premise / private cloud deployment option - Custom SLA and uptime guarantee (99.99%) - Dedicated infrastructure - Quarterly business reviews - API access (10,000+ requests/min) 5.2 Billing Cycle ------------------ - Monthly plans are billed on the same date each month. - Annual plans are billed upfront for the full year. - Annual plans include a 17% discount compared to monthly billing. - Invoices are sent via email and available at app.acmecorp.com/billing. 5.3 Upgrading or Downgrading ------------------------------ - Upgrade: Effective immediately; charged pro-rata for the remainder of the billing period. - Downgrade: Effective at the end of the current billing cycle. - Cancellation: Effective at the end of the current billing period. Data is retained for 60 days after cancellation before permanent deletion. ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 6: SECURITY & COMPLIANCE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 6.1 Data Security ------------------ - All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3. - Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. - Regular third-party penetration testing conducted quarterly. - SOC 2 Type II certified. - ISO 27001 certified. - GDPR compliant for EU customers. - Data residency options available for Enterprise customers (US, EU, IN). 6.2 Uptime & SLA ----------------- - Standard SLA: 99.9% uptime (approx. 8.7 hours downtime/year). - Professional SLA: 99.95% uptime. - Enterprise SLA: 99.99% uptime (approx. 52 minutes downtime/year). - Check live status at status.acmecorp.com. - Scheduled maintenance windows: Sundays 2:00 AM – 4:00 AM IST. - Customers are notified 72 hours in advance of planned maintenance. 6.3 Data Backup ---------------- - Automated daily backups retained for 30 days (Standard). - Automated hourly backups retained for 90 days (Enterprise). - Point-in-time recovery available for Enterprise customers. - Backup storage is geographically distributed across 3 regions. ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ END OF DOCUMENT ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
